headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2021, The Young Bucks vs. Kingston & Penta fought it out in a Street Fight match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 7.49 ? a strong outing in a physical tag team battle, part of the special Road Rager '21 card.
It was 2023 when Bill & Cage vs. Beretta & Sydal met in a Tournament Match, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 7.46 ? a good, competitive contest.
Back on this day in 2021, it was Andrade El Idolo's first night in AEW against Matt Sydal, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.33.

secondaries.text: That Friday in 2023, Jarrett & Hardy kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.32.
Rewind to 2021, when The Blade returned to the fold after just under 4 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
Back on this day in 2021, FTR & Wardlow arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.21.
